name: Badge Blitz

features.name: Hold & Spin
features.description: Six badges start three respins that reset.

features.name: Five-tier jackpot
features.description: Mini, Minor, Major, Mega and Grand.

review:
A 5x3 western with horse wilds, two bonuses and a five-tier jackpot. Six or more sheriff badges trigger Hold & Spin.

In the bonus, badges turn into money symbols and you get three respins – new badges, or Mini, Minor, Major and Mega jackpot symbols, reset the count, and filling every spot wins the Grand. There's a separate free spins bonus too. Up to 5,000x and a 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
